summary: Timeboxed research affiliate onboarding: VPN bridge, lab GPU loaner, SCIM duplicate identity and policy-exception request
description:
Issue summary: An external research affiliate (non-employee contractor engaged via partner lab) needs a short-term (6-week) onboarding that crosses multiple environments: corporate VPN for internal docs, a loaner Mac with limited GPU access to the internal GPU lab network (for small-scale experiments), and SSO/SCIM account provisioning. HR has requested a documented policy exception because background-check clearance is delayed (pending third-party verification).

Requested deliverables: 1) Create a timeboxed SSO account with SCIM sync disabled for attributes that would normally propagate to corporate groups; 2) Provision a VPN bridge user with strict ACLs and documented expiry; 3) Prepare a loaner laptop workflow that allows temporary lab GPU access without adding the affiliate to full employee groups; 4) Document compensating controls for compliance until background check completes.

Why this is urgent: Experiment start date is 2026-03-15 and the affiliate must validate a data pipeline against a staging model. Delays will push project milestones and affect a partner-funded milestone payment.
impact: Medium: project milestone at risk; no production data access requested. Access must be timeboxed and auditable.
background: Affiliate is onboarded by Research Partnerships and contracted through an academic partner (not a Redwood vendor). HR indicates the background-check provider reports a partial delay due to verification at a foreign institution; identity proofing is completed but adjudication step is pending. Security policy requires background adjudication before lab-level access; HR and Research ask for a short waiver under tight controls.
request:
IT/Security to approve and implement a time-limited access plan: 1) Create AzureAD SSO account scoped to a restricted group 'affiliate-temp-2026-03' with SCIM propagation suppressed; 2) Issue VPN credentials restricted to internal staging subnets only (no prod) with 2FA and device check; 3) Loaner device: MacBook with local user only, disk encryption enabled, no persistent KMS access; 4) Lab GPU access via managed jump host that enforces file-based data ingress controls and logs all sessions; 5) All artifacts and access to be revoked on 2026-04-26 automatically.

Additionally request a written policy exception approval from Security and HR recorded in Confluence.
constraints: No production model or customer data may be accessed. KMS keys for customer data are off-limits. SCIM group writes must not add affiliate to org-wide groups. Security requires MFA and endpoint telemetry (CrowdStrike) on loaner. The affiliate cannot use personal devices for lab GPU work.
